thread:
maria: quick heads-up — just hit a broken fragment in the runtime guide when following the 'batching' section. https://staging.redwood.ai/docs/runtime#batching jumps to the top instead of the subsection. anyone own that page?

alex: I skimmed the file — looks like the heading id changed during a tidy. probably a fragment mismatch.

maria: exact path i hit it on: docs/runtime/serving.md ~line 420. quick repro: `curl -sS https://staging.redwood.ai/runtime | grep -A2 'batching'` shows no fragment anchor.

jen: I can take a quick PR tomorrow morning. is the fix to add an explicit anchor or update the internal link?

sam: either works. prefer stable anchors in frontmatter if possible. pinging doc-bot to check last editor.

doc-bot: last edited by @alex on 2025-08-12 (commit 7f3a2c) — file: docs/runtime/serving.md

leo: alex, you touched that chunk earlier — can you confirm?

alex: yep that was me, I renamed a heading during the refactor and forgot the fragment. happy to drop a 2-line PR if nobody else beats me to it.

tiffany: if someone picks this up, can you also add a one-line changelog note? small housekeeping for release notes.

jen: I'll do the PR — plan: add an explicit HTML anchor above the heading and also add a frontmatter id to keep it stable. pushing branch `docs/fix/batching-anchor`.

jen: quick shell steps I'm going to run:
```bash
git checkout -b docs/fix/batching-anchor
# add <!-- anchor: batching --> above the heading in docs/runtime/serving.md
git add docs/runtime/serving.md
git commit -m "docs(runtime): restore 'batching' anchor and add stable frontmatter id"
git push origin docs/fix/batching-anchor
```

jen: PR created: https://git.internal.redwood.ai/r/redwood/docs/pull/4321 — small change, assigning @tiffany for the changelog line.

tiffany: ack, I'll add the changelog blurb in the release-notes PR.

sam: quick CR ask: @alex can you glance when you have 5 minutes? low-risk.

alex: looking now. small preference: also add a `id: batching` to the frontmatter so external links keep working. can you push a tiny follow-up commit to that branch?

jen: done — added `id: batching` to frontmatter and pushed commit 7b9e4c. updated PR.

alex: LGTM. merging now.

doc-bot: PR merged by @alex into main (commit 9c8d2f) — deployed to staging.

maria: thanks everyone :tada: — i'll drop a one-line test into the runtime smoke checklist to catch fragment regressions next time.

jen: thanks all. small and painless. :thumbsup:
